name: Sun-cleaned lidar window
subtitle: self-driving sensors that rain washes clean

effects.effect: sunlight makes a coated surface so water-loving that rain spreads flat

effect: sunlight makes a coated surface so water-loving that rain spreads flat
how: Self-driving cars see with lidar, which times laser pulses bouncing back from the road, but grime or beaded raindrops on its window scatter the beam and blind it, and today's fix is tiny wipers and washer jets. A window coating that sunlight turns so water-loving that rain spreads into a flat, clear sheet keeps the beam undistorted and lets the rain carry away road grime.
obstacle: The coating needs ultraviolet light to stay active, so it fades at night and in long tunnels, exactly when the car still has to see.
why: A proven window coating moved onto the sensor that most needs a clear view.
real: A patent application covers hydrophilic coatings for automotive lidar covers to form a uniform water film, and Pao et al. 2024 lab-tested hydrophilic lidar covers in rain, but no photocatalytic/sun-activated version found.
